integrity: Final mathematical claim confined to the prime-shift progression, with explicit Vieta-chain proof and Dirichlet prime progression. Mills (1953) covers the broader shifted-composite result; no claim of external formal verification.
scientific_limitations: Only parameters k=41+21t; not a classification. Mills (1953) already proves shifted-composite infinite solvability and supplies the k=41 instance. Possible implicit earlier coverage of the uniform progression remains a priority risk.
title: An infinite prime-shift progression for reciprocal quadratic divisibility
